name: Pinball Arcade: Gladiators
storyline: Gladiators (1993) is a feature-filled table designed by Jon Norris. This exciting table invites players to take on the role of a futuristic Gladiator trying to defeat a 3-headed Dragon. Along the way, players must prove themselves worthy by completing 6 Pyramid Rounds such as a Blade Fight, the Rain of Terror, and a Catapult Round, all playable as Timed or Multiball Rounds. Players can also control the Catapult Habitrail for the Attack Mode, and explore the Abyss under an Upper Flipper. Take the Challenge, Brave One! 1,995 units of this table were produced.
